assessments.reasoning:
The survey instrument's handling of the four dimensions collapsed into 'headship' is evaluated as follows:

1. economic_maintenance (TRUE): Sección 6, Parte E (pp. 29-30) records income from all individual sources (employment, self-employment, rentals, interest/dividends, family support, pensions, Tekoporá, Adulto Mayor, child support, and remittances) at the individual member level, identified by person line numbers.
2. labor_burden (FALSE): While hours spent in paid work are recorded per member in Sección 6, Parte B (Question 3), hours spent in unpaid domestic or care work are not collected at the member level. Unpaid housework is only recorded as a categorical reason for inactive status or reduced paid work hours in Sección 6, Parte A.
3. property_asset_control (FALSE): Dwelling tenure and plot ownership (Sección 2, Questions 16-17), durable asset ownership (Sección 2, Question 24), and agricultural land ownership (Sección 8, Question 3) are captured at the household level, not attributed to individual members.
4. decision_making (FALSE): The questionnaire contains no questions capturing who makes decisions within the household regarding child-rearing, daily expenditure, or major financial choices.
